name: service-run-sheet
title: Service run sheet
for_each: select id,name from services where status='planned'

sections.title: Service
sections.sql: select name,service_date,location from services where id=$1

sections.title: Order
sections.sql: select position,title,minutes from service_items where service_id=$1 order by position

sections.title: Roster
sections.sql: select role,person,response,finding from v_roster_review where id in(select id from rosters where service_id=$1) order by role
sections.note: Internal draft. Resolve findings before confirming assignments.

name: giving-statement
title: Giving statement draft
for_each: select distinct p.id,p.name from people p join giving g on g.person_id=p.id

sections.title: Recorded contributions
sections.sql: select g.donated_on,f.name fund,f.currency,g.amount_cents,g.reference from giving g join funds f on f.id=g.fund_id where g.person_id=$1 order by g.donated_on
sections.note: Reconcile to bank records. This is not an issued tax receipt.

sections.title: Totals by currency
sections.sql: select f.currency,sum(g.amount_cents)::bigint amount_cents from giving g join funds f on f.id=g.fund_id where g.person_id=$1 group by f.currency

name: donation-receipt
title: Donation receipt draft
for_each: select id,donor as name from v_giving

sections.title: Gift details
sections.note: DRAFT ONLY. A false review status means eligibility evidence is missing. The coordinator must verify donee or DGR status and whether this is a qualifying gift. Add official letterhead, an issue number, and an authorised name, designation and actual signature before issuing a New Zealand receipt. Record a copy or replacement label where applicable. Australian DGR gift receipts must identify the recipient fund, its ABN if any, and state that the contribution is a gift. No signature or eligibility is invented.

name: safeguarding-review
title: Safeguarding record review
for_each: select distinct p.id,p.name from people p join checks c on c.person_id=p.id

sections.title: Recorded evidence
sections.sql: select jurisdiction,checked_on,expires_on,outcome,verified_by,evidence from checks where person_id=$1 order by checked_on desc
sections.note: Restricted internal evidence. Not a government verification or permission to work with children.
